subject: Rename redisTLSContextConfig to serverTLSContextConfig (#176)
reason: The change only renames the typedef redisTLSContextConfig to serverTLSContextConfig in server.h and tls.c (including a comment). The struct's fields, layout, and all logic are untouched, so the compiled behaviour is identical on both builds. It is a pure refactor with no testable behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
